title: WorkStepTemplate - Data API
description: Represents a template for a work step. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

ActionDefinition.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ActionDefinition.description: The platform action that the work step executes. The possible values are the names of the flow and quick actions configured in your org.

ActionType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ActionType.description: The type of platform action that the work step is associated with. Possible values are: Flow QuickAction

Description.description: The description of the work step template.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Controls whether this work step template is active true or not false. Default is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last interacted with this record, directly or indirectly.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it's possible that the user only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The user-defined name of the work step template.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner who created the work step template.

associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. Unless noted, they’re available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkStepTemplateChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **WorkStepTemplateFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **WorkStepTemplateHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **WorkStepTemplateOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **WorkStepTemplateShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
